cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the wedding calls. Your date is still safe; the venue needs a little rearranging.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please tell me we still have the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We have the garden. I can move the chairs outside, but the hall won't open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stop planning around me. Is it repairs, or has something happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There was a fire. I'll stop making calls; tell me when you want to look at other places.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads reassuring planning, A3 offers garden seating to cushion loss of hall, and A5 gives B control after the direct objection while finally naming fire.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 hall request causes A3 partial surviving venue; B4 rejects protective planning and A5 both discloses cause and stops calls.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants an honest account and participation in decisions, not just another reassurance.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes A1 take-charge promise into waiting for B readiness because B4 explicitly contests being managed.

specificity.evidence: A1 wedding date, A3 garden/hall distinction and A5 fire progressively define the same event disruption.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 now proposes chairs instead of describing disclosure technique; A5 factual answer and planning concession have immediate purposes.

coach2.stated: A1 wedding date remains; A3 garden usable and hall closed; A5 fire and stop-calls offer.
coach2.inferred: A wants to protect B distress but needs B cooperation more than unilateral control.
coach2.missing: No sister or invented support call is needed.
coach2.firstDefect: Earlier disclosure explanation and imposed sister call removed.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 probes the hall behind A1 small-change reassurance.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 gives B2 a surviving garden while admitting lost hall.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 rejects A3 substitution plan and asks what happened.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 answers B4 cause and relinquishes the uninvited planning.
